hookScope: Set a hook on a scope the product owns, not on :root, so a runtime change restyles that scope only, for example .promo { --scnx-edge-layout-border-color: …; }.

hooks.purpose: The border-bottom, border-left and border-right of EdgeLayout's header, sidebar and start part.
hooks.coverage: industrial and achromatic, light and dark.
hooks.migration: Added in @scnx/system 2.0.0-beta.0, before v1; additive, no consumer change.
